=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided images as visual guidance for Riven
and the burning village environment.

Use the provided final frame from the previous sequence
to establish the beginning of this scene.

Maintain natural visual continuity.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Burning village at dusk.

Grounded realistic movement.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Dense smoke, drifting ash, embers, and firelight.

Mysterious and restrained atmosphere.

No clear creature reveal.

No combat sequence.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== SCENE ===

Begin directly from Riven standing inside the burning village.

She has suddenly stopped moving.

Her attention is fixed on something deeper in the smoke ahead.

Hold briefly on her uneasy expression.


Riven listens.

A faint sound comes from somewhere deeper inside the village.

She believes it might be her father.


Riven quietly calls:

"Father?"


No answer.


Riven begins moving carefully toward the sound.

She walks deeper between the damaged buildings.

Her sword remains intact and stays with her.


As Riven searches,
she notices strange dark marks
across damaged wood and the ground.

They look different from the ordinary fire damage around them.

Riven looks at them briefly,
confused by what she sees.

Then another faint sound comes from farther ahead.


Riven immediately continues toward it.


Smoke becomes thicker.

Visibility becomes increasingly poor.


Through the smoke ahead,
a vague dark shape briefly moves
between the ruined structures.


Riven stops.


She looks toward the movement.


For only a moment,
something resembling a distant dark silhouette
can barely be seen through the smoke.


Do not clearly reveal what it is.


The shape disappears.


Riven looks around,
trying to understand where it went.


Silence.


Then sudden movement comes from outside her field of view.


Riven turns toward it—

A powerful unseen impact suddenly hits her.


The source of the impact remains hidden.


Riven is knocked violently off balance
and thrown onto the ground.


Her intact sword is knocked from her hand.

The sword slides across the dirt
and comes to rest several feet away from her.


Riven remains conscious,
but stunned and exhausted.


End with Riven on the ground
and her intact sword lying beyond her reach.


Do not show what attacked her.


CUT.
